name: patch
// version: Headline <major>.<minor> only — the effective build version is major.minor.<commit count>, computed by scripts/version.mjs. Bump this by hand for a new headline number.
description: Patch — thin coordination layer over Claude Code (monorepo root)

scripts.// smoke:android: The SURFACE layer (spec/19-testing.md). Drives the shipped APK on a headless emulator through every tab and the whole new-chat flow, asserting each destination painted and that logcat reports no render loop, crash or ANR. Needs a paired surface JWT: PATCH_SMOKE_CREDENTIAL=$(cat ~/.patch/credential.jwt) pnpm smoke:android --apk <path> --sha <gitSha> --avd Pixel_7
scripts.// verify: THE gate (spec/19-testing.md § Verification) — every test layer that runs unattended, in one command. `pnpm test` stays the fast inner loop; this is what has to be green to deploy, and `pnpm run deploy` runs it first.
scripts.// deploy: THE deploy command — every surface at once (web, server, daemon, mobile OTA, mobile APK, desktop). Run from /srv/patch on the box. It detaches itself, because the daemon restart it ends with kills the chat that started it. See deploy.md.
scripts.// build:desktop: Signing is left ENABLED (auto-discovery). It used to force CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false, which produced an adhoc-signed app — and Squirrel refuses to apply an update to one, so the shell could never self-update. With a code-signing identity in the keychain this signs; without one electron-builder logs a loud 'skipped code signing' warning and you get a build that cannot auto-update. PATCH_SKIP_NOTARIZE=1 because notarization needs a paid Apple account (see spec/11 § Desktop code signing).
scripts.// build:daemon: The daemon's installable artifact per OS/arch (spec/11 § Daemon installation). Needs PATCH_BUILD_VENDOR (pinned Node runtimes + onnxruntime prebuilds + silero_vad.onnx) and PATCH_ARTIFACT_SIGNING_KEY; the darwin target also needs PATCH_CODESIGN_IDENTITY + PATCH_CODESIGN_ENTITLEMENTS. See packages/daemon/README.md.
scripts.// build:server: The server + SPA as one installable release (spec/11 § Server installation): dist/server/patch-server-<release>/ and its tarball. Install it with <release>/install — the same path `pnpm run deploy` uses on the box.
